# Proverbs 14 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** Wisdom-of women builds her-house, but-folly with-her-[own]-hands tears-it-down.

**2** One-walking in-his-uprightness fears YHWH, but-[one]-devious in-his-ways despises-Him.

**3** In-[the]-mouth-of a-fool [is] a-rod-of pride, but-[the]-lips-of [the]-wise preserve-them.

**4** Where-there-are-no oxen [the]-manger [is]-clean, but-much produce [is] by-[the]-strength-of an-ox.

**5** A-witness faithful does-not-lie, but-a-witness-of falsehood breathes-out lies.

**6** A-scoffer seeks wisdom and-there-is-none, but-knowledge to-[the]-discerning [is] easy.

**7** Go from-before a-man foolish, and-you-will-not-know lips-of knowledge.

**8** Wisdom-of [the]-prudent [is] to-understand his-way, but-[the]-folly-of fools [is] deceit.

**9** Fools mock at-guilt, but-among [the]-upright [is] favor.

**10** [The]-heart knows [the]-bitterness-of its-soul, and-in-its-joy a-stranger does-not-share.

**11** [The]-house-of [the]-wicked will-be-destroyed, but-[the]-tent-of [the]-upright will-flourish.

**12** There-is a-way [that is]-straight before a-man, but-its-end [are the]-ways-of death.

**13** Even in-laughter [the]-heart is-in-pain, and-its-end — joy [turns to] grief.

**14** From-his-ways will-be-filled [the]-backslider-of heart, and-from-upon-himself a-good man.

**15** [The]-simple believes every word, but-[the]-prudent considers his-step.

**16** [The]-wise fears and-turns-away from-evil, but-a-fool rages and-is-self-confident.

**17** One-quick-of anger does folly, and-a-man-of schemes is-hated.

**18** [The]-simple inherit folly, but-[the]-prudent are-crowned [with] knowledge.

**19** Evil-ones bow before good-ones, and-[the]-wicked at-[the]-gates-of [the]-righteous.

**20** Even by-his-neighbor [the]-poor is-hated, but-those-loving [the]-rich [are] many.

**21** One-despising his-neighbor sins, but-one-showing-grace-to [the]-poor — blessed [is]-he.

**22** Do-they-not go-astray — devisers-of evil? But-lovingkindness and-truth [are for] devisers-of good.

**23** In-all labor there-is profit, but-a-word-of lips [leads] only to-lack.

**24** [The]-crown-of [the]-wise [is] their-wealth; [the]-folly-of fools [is] folly.

**25** A-witness-of truth delivers souls, but-one-breathing lies [is] deceit.

**26** In-fear-of YHWH [is] confidence strong, and-for-His-children it-will-be a-refuge.

**27** Fear-of YHWH [is] a-fountain-of life, to-turn-away from-snares-of death.

**28** In-[the]-multitude-of people [is the]-glory-of a-king, but-in-[the]-lack-of a-nation [is the]-ruin-of a-ruler.

**29** Slow-of anger [has] great understanding, but-quick-of spirit exalts folly.

**30** A-heart-of healing [is] life-of [the]-flesh, but-rottenness-of [the]-bones [is] envy.

**31** One-oppressing [the]-poor reproaches his-Maker, but-one-showing-grace-to [the]-needy honors-Him.

**32** In-his-evil [the]-wicked is-thrust-down, but-[the]-righteous takes-refuge in-his-death.

**33** In-[the]-heart-of [the]-discerning wisdom rests, but-in-[the]-midst-of fools it-is-made-known.

**34** Righteousness exalts a-nation, but-sin [is] a-disgrace-of peoples.

**35** [The]-favor-of a-king [is] to-a-servant [who]-acts-wisely, but-his-wrath will-be [against one]-causing-shame.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **14:4**: Paradoxical wisdom — cleanness comes at the cost of productivity. The mess of the ox is the price of the harvest.

- **14:10**: Lev yode'a marat nafsho — 'the heart knows the bitterness of its soul.' Profound statement on the irreducible privacy of human experience.

- **14:12**: Yesh derekh yashar — 'there is a way straight.' Repeated verbatim in 16:25. The most solemn warning in Proverbs about self-deception.

— EMET
